content.value: The distance between conductors of a single phase line is 10 feet. Each (15) conductor is composed of seven equal strands. The diameter of each strand is 0.1 inch. Show that D<sub>s</sub> for the conductor is 2.177 times the radius of each strand. Find the inductance of the line in milihenrys per mile.
